senses.gloss:
अल्प a. [अल्-प]
—1 Trifling, unimportant, insignificant (opp. महत् or गुरु);
 अल्पविद्यः Ms. 11. 36.
—2 Small, little, minute, scanty (opp. बहु); अल्पस्य हेतोर्बहु
 हातुमिच्छन् R. 2. 47, 1. 2; अल्पकुचान्तरा V. 4. 49.
—3 Mortal, of short existence; अथ यदल्पं तन्मर्त्यम् Ch. Up.
—4 Young.
—5 Seldom, rare.
अल्प + .{@-ल्पः@} A class of buildings; Kāmikāgama 45. 53-54.
अल्प + .{@-ल्पम्@} Very little.

अल्प + .{@-ल्पम्, -ल्पेन, -ल्पात्@} adv.
—1 A little.
—2 For a slight reason; प्रीतिरल्पेन भिद्यते Rām. 4. 32. 7.
—3 Easily, without much trouble or difficulty.

अल्प + -अच्तर (comparative) A word consisting of a smaller number of
 syllables (than another) अल्पाच्तरम् P. II. 2. 34.

अल्प + -अल्प a. very little or minute, little by little; तथाल्पाल्पो
 ग्रहीतव्यो राष्ट्रादाज्ञाऽऽब्दिकः करः Ms. 7. 129; ˚भासम् Me. 83.
अल्प + -असु = ˚प्राण q. v.

अल्प + -प्राण, -असु a. having little power or strength, having short
 breath, asthmatic; ˚णश्च क्रियासु भवति Suśr.
अल्प + -आकाङ्क्षिन् a. desiring little, contented or satisfied with little.
अल्प + -आयुस् a. shortlived; Ms. 4. 157.

अल्प + -आयुस् + .({@-युः@}) m.
—1 a young one, cub.
—2 a goat.
अल्प + -आरम्भः a small or gradual beginning; अल्पारम्भः क्षेमकरः.
अल्प + -आहार, -आहारिन् a. eating little, moderate in diet, abstemious.
अल्प + -आहार, -आहारिन् + .({@-रः@}) taking little food, moderation, abstinence in food.
अल्प + -आहार, -आहारिन् a. eating little, moderate in diet, abstemious.
अल्प + -इच्छु a. moderate in wishes, seeking little.

अल्प + -इतर a.
—1 other than small, large.
—2 other than few, many; as ˚राः कल्पनाः many or various ideas.
अल्प + -ईशाख्य a. Named after an insignificant chief or master, of low origin.
अल्प + -ऊन a. slightly defective, not quite complete.
अल्प + -उपायः small means.
अल्प + -कार्यम् a small matter.

अल्प + -केशी
—1 N. of a plant (भूतकेशी; Mar. जटामांसी, निर्गुडी).
—2 the root of a sweet flag.
अल्प + -क्रीत a. bought for a small sum, cheap.
अल्प + -गोधूमः A kind of wheat (Mar. जोडगहू or खपल्या गहू)
अल्प + -गन्ध a. having little scent or odour.
अल्प + -गन्ध + .({@-न्धम्@}) a red lotus.
अल्प + -चेष्टित a. inert.

अल्प + -च्छद, -च्छाद a. scantily clad; दूरादेव महाजनस्य विहरत्यल्पच्छदो
 लज्जया Mk. 1. 37.

अल्प + -च्छद, -च्छाद a. scantily clad; दूरादेव महाजनस्य विहरत्यल्पच्छदो
 लज्जया Mk. 1. 37.
अल्प + -ज्ञ a. knowing little, shallow, superficial.

अल्प + -तनु a.
—1 of short stature, dwarfish, short.
—2 weak, thin.
—3 having small bones.
अल्प + -तनु + .({@-नुः@}) a kind of tree.

अल्प + -दक्षिण a. defective in presents (as a ceremony), not liberal
 in sacrificial gifts; न त्वल्पदक्षिणैर्यज्ञैर्यजेतेह कथंचन;
[]
 हन्त्यल्पदक्षिणो यज्ञः Ms. 11. 39. 40.
अल्प + -दृष्टि a. narrow-minded, short-sighted.

अल्प + -धन a. of little wealth, not affluent or rich, poor; Ms. 3. 66;
 नाल्पधनो यजेत् 11. 40.
अल्प + -धी n. weak-minded, having little, sense, foolish.
अल्प + -नासिकः A small vestibule; Māna. 34. 106.

अल्प + -पत्रः
—1 N. of a plant (a species of the Tulsi).
—2 a tree having a few leaves. (Mar. शोपा, मुसळी).
अल्प + -पद्मम् a red lotus.

अल्प + -पशु a. Ved. having a small number of cattle. अनपत्यमल्पपशुं
 वशा कृणोति पुरुषम् Av. 12. 4. 25.
अल्प + -पुण्य a. Whose religious merit is small; Rām.; Mbh.
अल्प + -पुष्पिका N. of a flower-plant (Mar. पिवळी कण्हेर).

अल्प + -प्रजस् a. having few descendants or subjects. नित्यमसिच्
 प्रजामेधयोः P. V. 4. 122.

अल्प + -प्रभाव a. of small weight or consequence, insignificant,
 unimportant; ˚त्वम् insignificance.

अल्प + -प्रमाण, -प्रमाणक a.
—1 of little weight or measure.
—2 of little authority, resting on little evidence.

अल्प + -प्रमाण, -प्रमाणक a.
—1 of little weight or measure.
—2 of little authority, resting on little evidence.
अल्प + -प्रमाण, -प्रमाणक + .({@-णः, -णकः@}) common cucumber.
अल्प + -प्रमाण, -प्रमाणक + .({@-णः, -णकः@}) common cucumber.
अल्प + -प्रयोग a. of rare application or use, rarely used.

अल्प + -प्राण, -असु a. having little power or strength, having short
 breath, asthmatic; ˚णश्च क्रियासु भवति Suśr.

अल्प + -प्राण, -असु + .({@-णः@})
—1 slight breathing or weak aspiration.
—2 (in gram.) a name given to the unaspirated letters of the alphabet
 (in pronouncing which little effort is required); अयुग्मा वर्गयमगा
 यणश्चाल्पासवः स्मृताः Sk. i. e. the vowels, semivowels, nasals and
 the letters क् च् ट् त् प् ग् ज् ड् द् ब्.
अल्प + -बल a. weak, feeble, having little strength.

अल्प + -बाध a. causing little annoyance or inconvenience, not very
 harmful; न निषेध्योऽल्पबाधस्तु Y. 2. 156.
अल्प + -बुद्धि, -मति a. weak-minded, unwise, silly, ignorant; Ms. 12. 74.
अल्प + -बुद्धि, -मति a. weak-minded, unwise, silly, ignorant; Ms. 12. 74.
अल्प + -भाग्य a. unfortunate.
अल्प + -भाषिन् a. speaking little, taciturn.
अल्प + -मध्यम a. slender-waisted.

अल्प + -मात्रम्
—1 a little, a little merely. —2 a short time, a few moments.

अल्प + -मारिषः [अल्पः मारिषः शाक˚ कर्मधा˚] a kind of amaranth
 (शाक) Amaranthus Polygamus (Mar. तांदुळजा).
अल्प + -मूर्ति a. small-bodied, diminutive, dwarfish.
अल्प + -मूर्ति + .({@-र्तिः@} f.) a small figure or object.
अल्प + -मूल्य a. of small value, cheap.

अल्प + -मेधस् (see Kāśi. on P. V. 4. 122.) a. of little understanding,
 ignorant, silly. पुरुषस्याल्पमेधसः Kaṭh. 1. 8; तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् Bg. 7. 23.
अल्प + -वयस् a. young in age, youthful.
अल्प + -वर्तिका N. of a bird (Mar. गांजीण).
अल्प + -वादिन् a. speaking little, taciturn.
अल्प + -विद्य a. ignorant, ill-taught, uneducated; Ms. 11. 36.

अल्प + -विषय a. —1 of limited range or capacity; क्व चाल्पविषया
 मतिः R. 1. 2.
—2 engaged in trifling matters.
अल्प + -शक्ति a. of little strength, weak, feeble.
अल्प + -शमी a small tree like शमी.
अल्प + -सत्त्व a. Having little strength or courage; Ks.

अल्प + -सरस् n. a basin, a small pond (one which is shallow or dry
 in hot seasons).
अल्प + -सार a. Of little value; द्रव्याणामल्पसाराणां स्तेयम् Ms. 11. 164.

अल्पक a. (-ल्पिका f.)
—1 Small, little, minute.
—2 Contemptible, mean; Śi. 16. 28; नाग्निपरिशुद्धिमपि अल्पकाः प्रतिपद्यन्ते U. 4.
अल्पक + .{@-कम्@} Little.
अल्पक + .{@-कः@} N. of a plant (यवास; Mar. धमासा).

अल्पता, -त्वम्
—1 smallness, minuteness; Bh. 3. 47.
—2 Smallness of intellect, folly; Ki. 6. 37.
—3 Inferiority, insignificance.

अल्पता, -त्वम्
—1 smallness, minuteness; Bh. 3. 47.
—2 Smallness of intellect, folly; Ki. 6. 37.
—3 Inferiority, insignificance.
अल्पंपच a. Cooking little, stingy, niggardly.
अल्पंपच + .{@-चः@} A miser.

अल्पशः ind.
—1 In a low degree, slightly, a little; बहुशो ददाति आभ्युदयिकेषु,
 अल्पशः श्राद्धेषु P. V. 4. 42. Com.; P. II. 1. 38.
—2 Separately.
—3 Seldom, now and then.

अल्पित a. [अल्प कृतार्थे णिच् कर्मणि-क्त]
—1 Diminished.
—2 Lowered in estimation, disparaged; मृषा न चक्रेऽल्पितकल्पपादपः N. 1. 15.
अल्पिष्ठ a. [अतिशयेन अल्पः इष्ठन्] Least, smallest, very small.
अल्पीकृ €8 U. To make small, diminish, reduce in number, commute.
अल्पीभूत a. Become small, diminished, reduced in number.
अल्पीयस् a. [अतिशयेन अल्पः ईयसुन्] Smaller, less; very small.
